scope: Theorem 1.3 (Fixed-dimension ETH consequence) of the manuscript “Parity lifts and bounded-treewidth witnesses for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence” (preprints/Parity-lifts-and-bounded-treewidth-witnesses-for-Weisfeiler-Leman-equivalence-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 133 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 742b4b63acfcfeec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume positive exponential-rate ETH. There are constants c > 0 and K ≥ 4 such that, for every fixed integer k ≥ K, no deterministic algorithm decides k-WL equivalence of two n-vertex graphs in time O(nck). This holds for both joint and separate refinement. The inputs are explicit adjacency matrices of uncolored simple undirected graphs, and time is measured on a multitape Turing machine.
